title: SOUND CLUB and restaurant (CLUB del MAR) Palma de Mallorca — Architecture → Systems → As-Built

scenes.title: From venue to integrated system
scenes.body: Architecture, hospitality and technical infrastructure are presented as one coordinated environment.

scenes.title: Building exploded into layers
scenes.body: Envelope, ceiling, lighting, audio and operational layers separate to explain how the venue works.

scenes.title: Zones before objects
scenes.body: Lighting and hospitality zones become a legible plan: pendants, dance spots, DJ strip and scene control.

scenes.title: DJ booth as a technical object
scenes.body: Furniture, professional audio, service access and lighting are treated as one bespoke built component.

scenes.title: Dimensions stay separate from generated geometry
scenes.body: The booth diagram exposes the documented base dimensions while keeping CAD/SKP verification as the final geometric authority.

scenes.title: 2300 K as visual language
scenes.body: The portfolio layer uses warm 2300 K imagery as a communication target; technical/as-built lighting values remain documented separately.

scenes.title: Signal distribution by zone
scenes.body: MIMO88 routing, amplification and interior/exterior loudspeaker groups are reduced to a clean technical distribution layer.

scenes.title: KNX and DALI as one operating layer
scenes.body: Gira X1, DALI, dimming and scene logic are shown as a coordinated control topology.

scenes.title: Mechanical decoupling becomes visible
scenes.body: The installed suspended structure is explained as ceiling anchor, spring isolator, M8 rod, clamp and Ø48.3 mm structural pipe.

scenes.title: One system, several disciplines
scenes.body: Audio, lighting, control, fabrication and documentation converge in the final architecture while original source media remains private.
